title: Cryptanalysis of the Legendre Pseudorandom Function over Extension Fields
summary: The Legendre Pseudorandom Function (PRF) is a highly efficient cryptographic primitive built upon the Legendre symbol, valued for its low multiplicative complexity in Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) protocols. While its security over prime fields $\mathbb{F}_p$ is well-documented, recent interest has shifted toward instantiations over extension fields $\mathbb{F}_{p^r}$.
